name: GGKMS.finite_bayesian_dominant_equivalence
declaration:
theorem GGKMS.finite_bayesian_dominant_equivalence.{uI, uK} {I : Type uI} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] {K : Type uK} [Fintype K]
  {n : I → Nat} (p θ : (i : I) → GGKMS.Types n i → Real) (hp : GGKMS.SupportPrior p) (hθ : ∀ (i : I), StrictMono (θ i))
  (a c : I → K → Real) (_ha : ∀ (i : I) (k : K), LE.le 0 (a i k)) (q₀ : GGKMS.Profile (GGKMS.Types n) → K → Real)
  (pay₀ : I → GGKMS.Profile (GGKMS.Types n) → Real) (hfeasible : GGKMS.Feasible q₀) (hBIC : GGKMS.BIC p θ a c q₀ pay₀) :
  Exists fun q =>
    Exists fun pay =>
      And (GGKMS.Feasible q)
        (And (GGKMS.DIC θ a c q pay)
          (And
            (∀ (i : I) (t : GGKMS.Types n i),
              Eq (GGKMS.interimPayoff p θ a c q pay i t t) (GGKMS.interimPayoff p θ a c q₀ pay₀ i t t))
            (And (Eq (GGKMS.socialSurplus p θ a c q) (GGKMS.socialSurplus p θ a c q₀))
              (And (GGKMS.Matches p a q q₀)
                (And
                  (∀ (i : I) (t : GGKMS.Types n i),
                    Eq (GGKMS.modifiedInterim p c q pay i t) (GGKMS.modifiedInterim p c q₀ pay₀ i t))
                  (∀ (q' : GGKMS.Profile (GGKMS.Types n) → K → Real),
                    GGKMS.Matches p a q' q₀ →
                      LE.le (GGKMS.energy (GGKMS.joint p) a q) (GGKMS.energy (GGKMS.joint p) a q')))))))

name: GGKMS.weighted_monotone_lifting
declaration:
theorem GGKMS.weighted_monotone_lifting.{uI, uT, uK} {I : Type uI} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] {T : I → Type uT}
  [(i : I) → Fintype (T i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (T i)] {K : Type uK} [Fintype K] [(i : I) → Preorder (T i)]
  (p : (i : I) → T i → Real) (hp : GGKMS.SupportPrior p) (a : I → K → Real) (q₀ : GGKMS.Profile T → K → Real)
  (hq₀ : GGKMS.Feasible q₀) (hmono : ∀ (i : I), Monotone (GGKMS.slope p a q₀ i)) :
  Exists fun q =>
    And (GGKMS.Matches p a q q₀)
      (And (∀ (i : I) (y : GGKMS.Opponents T i), Monotone fun t => GGKMS.value a q i (GGKMS.pack i t y))
        (∀ (q' : GGKMS.Profile T → K → Real),
          GGKMS.Matches p a q' q₀ → LE.le (GGKMS.energy (GGKMS.joint p) a q) (GGKMS.energy (GGKMS.joint p) a q')))

name: GGKMS.minimizer_monotone
declaration:
theorem GGKMS.minimizer_monotone.{uI, uT, uK} {I : Type uI} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] {T : I → Type uT}
  [(i : I) → Fintype (T i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (T i)] {K : Type uK} [Fintype K] [(i : I) → Preorder (T i)]
  (p : (i : I) → T i → Real) (hp : GGKMS.SupportPrior p) (a : I → K → Real) (q q₀ : GGKMS.Profile T → K → Real)
  (hq : GGKMS.Matches p a q q₀) (hmono : ∀ (i : I), Monotone (GGKMS.slope p a q₀ i))
  (hmin :
    ∀ (q' : GGKMS.Profile T → K → Real),
      GGKMS.Matches p a q' q₀ → LE.le (GGKMS.energy (GGKMS.joint p) a q) (GGKMS.energy (GGKMS.joint p) a q'))
  (i : I) (y : GGKMS.Opponents T i) : Monotone fun t => GGKMS.value a q i (GGKMS.pack i t y)
